about_item: [Certified Orthopedic Support] Experience professional-grade comfort with our unique "egg crate" foam core, designed to evenly distribute weight and provide crucial support for your dog's hips and joints. This certified CertiPUR-US foam free from harmful chemicals, offering dual safety assurance when combined with our OEKO-TEX certified fabric.

[Cloud-Like Comfort & Certified Safety] Indulge your pet with an incredibly soft, plush surface that feels like a warm embrace. This premium, short-pile fabric is not only luxuriously cozy but also OEKO-TEX certified, guaranteeing 100% skin-safe contact free from any harmful substances.

[Waterproof & Effortless Cleaning] Enjoy complete peace of mind with a high-density foam core fully protected by a waterproof membrane, effectively blocking liquids and preventing odors. The entire cozy shell is easily removable and machine washable, making cleanup quick and simple.

[Non-Slip Base & Lasting Durability] Ensure your dog's safety with a bottom covered in dense, non-slip silicone dots that grip floors securely, preventing the bed from sliding during play or rest. The high-resiliency certified foam maintains its shape for long-lasting comfort and support.

[Versatile & Stylish Design] Perfect for modern living, this bed is a comfortable spot in your living room or bedroom, a perfect travel companion for the car, and fits most crates. Its clean, minimalist design seamlessly blends with any home decor, providing both professional pet care and stylish aesthetics.

authors_reviews.title: Good look and dogs love them
authors_reviews.text: Good quality. Easy to wash. Soft and comfy for pets
authors_reviews.author: Jennifer Wentz

authors_reviews.title: Beautifully Done With Quality
authors_reviews.text: These dog beds are the best I’ve seen in years for the following reasons: OEKO-TEX means fabrics are safe and zero smell or off-gassing. The plush cover has a zipper that goes almost 75% around so very easy to insert the foam, which has it’s own zipper cover. All of my dogs have fought to get on the new bed, so I ordered a medium size for fireplace lounging. Finally, everything is pure quality and looks pricier than amount paid. The size fit perfectly a crate that bed had gotten lumpy. Allow a few days for the foam to fully expand. It will fit perfectly. I’m very happy and pleased with this purchase and will order more for other crates. Just beauty, comfort and class🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
authors_reviews.author: wench34

authors_reviews.title: So soft...
authors_reviews.text: I purchased the 3" height for my dog's crate (dog currently around 80lbs) and I was pleasantly surprised to see that to the top of the peaks it is actually a little over 3". The foam is firm, appears to be good quality, and supports my dog without pancaking. There is a separate zippered waterproof encasement. The outside cover is amazing. The faux fur is a beautiful color and it feels wonderful. Everything appears to be sewn well, the zippers are sturdy, and my dog loves it. As a nice bonus, there was a card included that you can scan for a free 2-year warranty. The price is a great deal for the quality.
authors_reviews.author: KT

authors_reviews.title: Great bed, but firmer than expected!
authors_reviews.text: I was a little worried when it arrived in a very small package, however when it fully expanded, it was a great size and the shape was perfect! The outer cover is very soft and a beautiful color, just like the picture. The bed itself is very firm, moreso than I expected, however it is durable for sure and I do think my pup will love it!
